messages:
Jordan (AE): Quick note 1: ArgoTech POC timeline: 2 weeks. Start hosted API keys in EU, likely request Dedicated pool + VPC by day 7. Need a short internal runbook + pricing note for procurement. Who can lead?
Priya (SE): I can take lead. Need expected qps, model family (opt/gpt), and whether embeddings will be used. Also will prepare the short security attachment for procurement.
Jordan (AE): They estimate ~60 rps peak, chat + embeddings later. Prefer open models. EU-only.
Ethan (Platform Eng): Hosted start is straightforward: trial org + ephemeral API key. For Dedicated, recommend 1x8 GPU pool with autoscale; VPC requires infra intake and ~10 business days lead time.
Lina (Security): Notes for procurement: SOC2 report, KMS integration, EU tenancy, minimal logs retention. I'll draft answers to their questionnaire and list exhibits.
Priya (SE): Draft onboarding runbook (short):
- Step A: Create trial org in eu-west and generate ephemeral API key
- Step B: Share quickstart repo + cURL and SDK examples
- Step C: Add org-level cost cap and alerting
- Step D: Collect ops/security contacts and approve data types
- Step E: If Dedicated requested, open infra ticket and schedule sizing call
Ethan (Platform Eng): Internal CLI snippet to create trial org:
```
# internal
rwctl org create --name "argotech-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org argotech-poc --note "poc-ephemeral"
```
Priya (SE): I'll spin up a quick smoke test in eu-west-1 and share results. Also will include a 2-week cost estimate with a usage cap.
Jordan (AE): Procurement question: can we offer a one-time POC credit or short discount and who's the billing contact?
Ethan (Platform Eng): Suggest messaging: "POC usage billed at standard rates; apply one-time credit if converted to Dedicated within 30 days." Dedicated commit estimate and lead time called out separately.
infra-bot: ticket POC-VPC-198 created for ArgoTech by Ethan.
Priya (SE): I'll own the POC onboarding and coordinate with Lina on security questionnaire responses. Jordan, I'll send the runbook to the customer after validation.
Jordan (AE): Great. Schedule kickoff with ArgoTech tomorrow. :calendar:
